For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three:

MakeMyTrip myBiz — Best suited to an India-first SME setup. Combines flight/hotel booking, travel policy, approvals, expense tracking, GST workflows and HRMS/expense integrations. Pricing is quote-based. 
MakeMyTrip Biz

FCM Travel — More full-service and globally oriented. Offers negotiated corporate rates, 24/7 support, traveller-risk tools, approvals, reporting and integrations. Particularly relevant if employees travel internationally. 
FCM Travel
+1

Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel — Stronger human-service/assisted-booking option, with air, hotels, rail, visas, forex, insurance, cars and MICE under one provider. It also offers self-booking, expense tools and 24/7 emergency support. 
Thomas Cook

Key difference: myBiz is more platform/SME-led, FCM is global TMC + technology, while Thomas Cook is high-touch, broad travel servicing. Exact management/convenience fees should be requested in the quote.

Subscription billing software for Indian SaaS

Shortlist these three: Razorpay Subscriptions, Zoho Billing and Chargebee. Razorpay is pay-as-you-go with a standard platform fee of 0.5% plus payment charges. Zoho Billing Premium is $100/month, or $79/month annually (approximately ₹6,600/month at ₹83/$). Chargebee has custom pricing and a free plan. Compare Indian payment support, GST, proration, dunning, revenue recognition, usage billing, multi-currency, APIs and total processing fees.
